base: V3 output separation; no reverse verification

B.sample: uniform sequence; 50% uniformly visible frame, 50% small half within sequence; fixed first-frame template
B.checkpoint_selection: last epoch fixed before training; no Test selection
B.trainable: existing LoRA, token type embeddings and MLP head; original DINO backbone frozen

C.backbone: B final checkpoint, frozen during first comparison-head experiment
C.feature: shared fused template foreground/background, candidate ROI and search context; no second image encoder
C.pool: local plus all current active YOLO candidates; deduplicate spatially
C.mining: all 1268 training sequences causally; no later GT passed to tracker; labels only in sample writer
C.storage: retain every 8th frame plus wrong-output and multiple-spatial-candidate training frames
C.supervision: setwise target selection including unmatched; separate localization quality

validation: All 132 complete YOLO-held-out validation sequences; development validation, not an unseen blind test
evaluations: B_POOL same proposals without learned selection
limitations: Single fixed seed initial research run; no claim of convergence or stable gain.
Existing sequence partition; common source/capture grouping beyond sequence IDs is not available.
Validation split was already used for YOLO checkpoint selection.
